stem: In 6 years, Ramon will be 31 years old. How old was Ramon 4 years ago?
hints: Make a small table: Past (4 years ago), Now, Future (in 6 years). You already know the Future age.
Let x = Ramon's age now. In 6 years he will be x + 6, so x + 6 = 31.
Find x by taking 6 from 31. Then go back 4 more years from his age now.

steps.why: Always name the unknown first. Ages now are the easiest to build the other ages from.

steps.action: Make the table. Now: x. In 6 years: x + 6. 4 years ago: x − 4.
steps.why: Future ages add years. Past ages take years away.

steps.action: In 6 years he will be 31, so x + 6 = 31.
steps.why: The Future box must equal the age the problem gives.

steps.action: Take 6 from both sides: x = 31 − 6 = 25. Ramon is 25 now.
Check: 21 + 4 = 25 (now), and 25 + 6 = 31 (in 6 years). It matches. Ramon was 21 years old 4 years ago.
steps.why: Putting the answer back into the story catches mistakes before you choose.

trapNotes.25: This is Ramon's age now (31 − 6). The question asks for his age 4 years ago, so take away 4 more.
trapNotes.27: This is 31 − 4. It goes back 4 years from his future age. First go back 6 years to get his age now.
trapNotes.41: This adds the years: 31 + 6 + 4. Going back in time means subtracting.
